patch_description: This version keeps the direct-link reward compact and uses at most two candidate two-hop routes per OD pair. Each route’s reward is explicitly scaled by normalized demand on both component links, while row/column shares and transit-node pressure help rank alternatives. A small positive direct-versus-route interaction discourages redundant choices. The construction generates at most four quadratic terms per OD pair, remaining within the \(4n^3\) limit, and uses no randomness.
